user.title: Connect to a GW-Modbus(A) gateway
user.description: The gateway must have Modbus TCP enabled and be reachable from Home Assistant.

data_description.unit_id: The Modbus address configured in the gateway web interface.
data_description.idu_addresses: Comma-separated addresses and ranges from 0 to 63. This installation defaults to 0-31 for its 32 indoor units; edit the range if the actual addresses are not continuous.
data_description.odu_addresses: Optional comma-separated addresses and ranges from 0 to 31.
data_description.idu_types: Optional address:type overrides, for example: 0:vrf,2:hthm. Types are auto, vrf, and hthm.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the gateway or read the selected device address.
error.invalid_input: Check the device ranges, type overrides, and temperature limits.

abort.already_configured: This gateway and Modbus address are already configured.
